programme.desc: Sky loses her cool when Ceaser puts her in charge of 113. Kevin musters the courage to come out to his homophobic father. After an STD scare, Ceaser is forced to break up with his side chicks. Donna's ex-roommate trashes her on the news.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Donna seeks revenge on her ex-roommate. Bae is worried for her mom's safety after she receives death threats from her father. Alex's freedom hangs in the balance.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Ceaser rushes to NYC to bail out Alex, while Walt finally scores a date with Jadah. A tattooathon turns ugly when a new manager-in-training crosses the line. The crew is shocked when an OG Black Ink artist returns to the shop.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew hopes a flash mob apology will get Melody to come back to the shop. Sky gets emotional over her tense relationship with her son Genesis. And Walt flips out after Jadah makes him look like a fool.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew heads to Korea to find Bae's mom. Sky goes on the attack after hearing a rumor about Ted and Kitty. Bae fears the worst when the search for her mom hits a dead end. And Donna is shocked by the results of a pregnancy test.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Bae continues the search in Korea for her missing mom while struggling to deal with her pregnancy. O'Sh*t clashes with Alex over a client. And Sky becomes unhinged as she begins to question Bae's past.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew calls Sky out for her behavior in Korea. Nikki drops a bomb on O'Sh**t. Bae is shocked by Rob's reaction to the news that she's pregnant. And Ceaser and Kitty rekindle their romance, while Jadah attempts to play matchmaker for Walt.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: O'S**t rushes to Atlanta for the birth of his fourth child. Sky freaks out when Ceaser contacts her son, Genesis. Bae wants a shotgun wedding, but Rob has other plans. And Ceaser has an emotional meeting with Sky's son.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: Melody meets her father's estranged family for the first time while the rest of the crew heads to the slopes. Ceaser plans some grand romantic gestures for Kitty. Sky loses her cool when Teddy hooks up with a fellow Black Ink employee.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew
programme.desc: The crew turns up at Bae's bachelorette party. Sky spreads a rumor about Jadah. Donna is in hot water after Alex posts a scandalous video. Sky attempts to repair her relationship with the son she gave up for adoption 15 years ago.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: The gang turns up on Bourbon Street in the spirit of Glenda. Kitty considers Charmaine's job offer, but Jess is left in the dark. Don helps Phor get answers about his potential daughter while Prince makes a tough decision.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Kitty lands in Chicago with a splash, making waves with the 2nd City crew. Tensions reach a boiling point when Jess confronts Char about Kitty's role at 2nd City. Ashley finally takes her marital matters into her own hands.
programme.sub-title: Some People Like Cake, Some People Do Not Like Cake

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: Ashley reveals the real reason she left Don. Jess flies back to London. Fly drops off Prince at the courthouse to turn himself in. Charmaine finds out the gender of her baby. The Chicago Tribune article drops and Van pops up to talk to Charmaine.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: After an incriminating article puts 2nd City on blast, Charmaine and Kitty do damage control with their artists by burying the lede. As news travels quickly, the truth about the article threatens to ruin Charmaine's lavish NYC baby shower.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: The future of 2nd City is in jeopardy while Charmaine attempts to secure the proper documents to legalize the shop. Ryan is forced to make some decisions about his love life. 9MAG and Charmaine come face to face again after their falling out.

programme.title: Black Ink Crew Chicago
programme.desc: When a romantic video of Ryan and Rachel vacationing in Mexico shows up on social media, a jilted Kitty bares her claws. Former Chicago Bull Eddy Curry gets a memorial tattoo. 2nd City Ink hosts an open call to expand the team.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Dr. Marvin P. Gunderson is summoned to examine Kitty Kat, the ailing lion pet of the Addams Family. Morticia decides that it is the doctor who needs help. To build his confidence, human members of the family pretend to be ill so he can effect cures.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia's favorite charity is having an auction--so Morticia persuades her family to part with things to sell. Donations include Wednesday's headless doll, the old flogging table, a stuffed vulture and Uncle Fester's dynamite.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandma Frump (guest star Margaret Hamilton), comes to the mistaken conclusion that her daughter, Morticia (Carolyn Jones), and Gomez (John Astin) plan to pack her off to an old folks home. Actually, they plan to send her to a beauty farm.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Newlyweds move in next door. But the honeymoon loses its tranquility when Uncle Fester enters their house through a tunnel and they flee in terror at the sight of Lurch, Grandmama sharpening her ax, and Morticia and Gomez bathing the octopus.
programme.sub-title: New Neighbors Meet The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez find Grandfather Pegleg's treasure map and summon Captain Grimby. They hope to charter his boat for the treasure hunt. But after meeting the Captain, Morticia is careful to keep the nature of the mission secret.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A pair of bank robbers are welcomed as Halloween trick-or-treaters by Morticia and Gomez. The creepy atmosphere of the house, Morticia's smoldering holiday punch, and Lurch's ominous presence impel the crooks to abandon their plans.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While Morticia and Gomez are celebrating their 13th wedding anniversary, she tells Wednesday and Pugsley a bedtime story of how she and Gomez first met. In this episode, Carolyn Jones plays Morticia, Morticia as a 22-year-old, and sister Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Wednesday and Pugsley refuse to go to bed until they hear the rest of the courtship story. Morticia resumes the tale via flashback, including the ceremony beginning with Ophelia Frump, Morticia's balmy sister, as the bride.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez see Fester conferring with TV muscleman Jack LaGrann (Jack LaLanne), and think that Fester is planning a television career. However, Uncle Fester confides to Lurch that he has to go on a secret diet and exercise.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Wednesday's and Pugsley's faith in Santa Claus is shaken, Uncle Fester is chosen to back up Santa in case the real St. Nick is too busy to come. However, Fester-Santa gets stuck in the chimney, so each of the other adults fills in for him.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez plays host to Don Xavier Molines, a family friend during his childhood in Spain, and his daughter Consuella. Morticia's hospitality is put to the test when Consuella reveals that she has been promised in marriage to Gomez since childhood.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: While enjoying a moonlight picnic and snail hunt, the Addams Family is mistaken for Martians by uniformed investigators from Mysterious Space Objects Headquarters. In turn, Gomez (John Astin) and the clan regard their inquisitors with suspicion.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family And The Spaceman

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Pugsley befriends Gorgo, a circus gorilla, Gorgo decides to follow Pugsley and Gomez home, where is accepted as one of the family. But Gorgo gives Morticia's tea guests, the Ladies League members, quite a shock.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley copies one of his dad's old love letters and sends it to his teacher. Miss Dunbar comes to visit the Addams home and confesses to Gomez that no man has ever fallen so in love with her, leading Morticia to pretend to be the jealous wife.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Ophelia laments that she has been jilted, Morticia suggests a career as an alternative to marriage. She tries chemistry first (with explosive results) then turns to operatic singing. Cousin Itt is summoned to coach her to stardom.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Pugsley and Wednesday start a row at a party when their gift of a tarantula upsets Harold, the birthday boy. Harold's parents insist that the Addams children lack breeding and, therefore, are no longer allowed to play with their son.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch becomes a veritable gazelle when he takes dancing lessons at Gomez and Morticia's suggestion after he admits to being a wallflower at social functions. Each member of the Addams Family teaches Lurch a different step.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: A recording company's platter of Lurch's gravelly voice brings a screaming mob of teenage fans to the Addams house. To calm the crowd, Lurch seats himself at the harpsichord and rewards his fans with a song to end all songs.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: After Wednesday befriends a new boy her age, Robespierre Courtney, Morticia invites his parents, Mr. and Mrs. Henry Courtney to visit the Addams house for tea. Unbeknownst to them, the Courtney's are hoping to meet a number of the social set.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Election fever grips the Addams household, as Gomez (John Astin) supports the council candidate whose campaign promise is to drain the town's disgusting bogs. Morticia (Carolyn Jones), who likes "the lovely bogs," labels the candidate an extremist.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Rockland Cartright III is a beatnik who crashes his motorbike into a tree and recuperates at the Addams house. Each regards the other as an oddity, although the family learns to appreciate certain aspects of Rockland's life.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets A Beatnik

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch's tiny fire-eating mother visits and demands that Lurch's employers wait on her boy hand-and-foot after Lurch leads her to believe that it's his house. Lurch revels in the unexpected attention he gets from Morticia and Gomez.
programme.sub-title: Mother Lurch Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Ophelia Frump is madly in love with Horatio Bartholomew, the man who has everything, except the truth about her relatives. Morticia, not convinced by Bartholomew, persuades playboy Cousin Itt to stir the embers of his past romance with Ophelia.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Morticia and Gomez decide to keep Wednesday and Pugsley home from school after Morticia sees the fairy tales they have to read. When the truant officer comes to investigate, he is shocked at what he finds.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Goes To School

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: The Addams Family ignores notices that their house is to be condemned to make way for a freeway. When sudden explosions cannot be traced to any member of the family but, instead, to city workmen, Gomez is forced to consider moving the house.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: When Uncle Fester incinerates the family's stuffed bear with his flamethrower, Morticia reports the accident to the insurance company. Mr. Henson the head of the company, sends his assistant, Mr. Digby, to handle the case.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: In need of artistic fulfillment, Morticia takes up sculpting. An art critic views her first endeavor--a three-eyed Gomez statue--and clubs it with his cane. Gomez, who won't have Morticia's heart broken gets a seedy art dealer to buy it.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Cousin Itt is advocated as curator of the local zoo. Gomez uses his influence with Park Commissioner Fisk (guest star Alan Reed) to promote Itt for the job, but the zookeepers are convinced the Addamses' cousin should be confined to a cage.
programme.sub-title: Cousin Itt Visits The Addams Family

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: An organ grinder's fugitive monkey leads Fester to believe that he has turned Pugsley into a monkey. Morticia and Gomez treat the monkey as though he were their son, welcoming him to the dinner table and giving him Pugsley's chores.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Grandmama (Blossom Rock) is hauled off to jail for setting up a fortune-telling booth in the Addamses' living room. Gomez (John Astin) volunteers to act as attorney, and the court session becomes a shambles.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Gomez decides to bolster Cousin Itt's failing ego by making him the star of a production aimed as a birthday surprise for Wednesday. He hires the great director, Eric von Bissell, who gives Itt elocution lessons, causing a Hollywood star complex.

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Official visitors from an unfriendly nation receive the shock of their lives when they decide to exploit the Addams Family as an average uncultured family. The visitors are shaken up by Morticia's carnivorous plants among other things.
programme.sub-title: The Addams Family Meets The V.I.P.'s

programme.title: The Addams Family
programme.desc: Lurch suffers from unrequited love over Tiny Trivia (guest star Diane Jergens), Morticia's visiting school chum who only has eyes for show business. The entire family decides to try to turn their stolid butler into a new personality.

programme.title: Almost Unsolved
programme.desc: After the meticulously planned murder of his family, a businessman successfully evades authorities for 18 years.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers
programme.desc: The story of the Baton Rouge Serial Killer, known for murdering seven women in the area and sentenced to death for his chilling crimes.

programme.title: World's Most Evil Killers: Harry Jarvis
programme.desc: When Carol Jarvis disappeared, her husband told friends and family that she'd simply gone on a little holiday.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: In August 2002, a young man and woman, once dating, headed for the Amazon rain forest but got lost in the jungle. They have to survive the dangers of the jungle and hold on to their sanity as they find their way home.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: When a Hollywood camera crew set out to film an active volcano they end up in a helicopter crash into the active volcano. All rescue attempts are delayed by lava, toxic gases and bad weather.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: 5 young guys from Bozeman, Montana have got together for a back-country ski trip to celebrate New Year 2005.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: I Hate Doctors
programme.desc: A hospital worker feels like she's dying, but doctors can find nothing wrong; a physician's young son is a patient in her own ER, demanding her attention while she's trying to treat others; a woman's hobby of wild mushroom picking sends her to the ER.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: Plastered
programme.desc: A college student is dropped off at the ER with her face covered in a plaster mask; doctors are baffled when a stroke patient's heart keeps stopping and restarting without intervention; two teens arrive separately with bizarre symptoms that are similar.

programme.title: Untold Stories of the ER: My Job Is Mayhem
programme.desc: A man injured in a medieval roleplaying battle has a sword impaled in his head; a critically ill patient is so afraid of germs he won't allow doctors to treat him; two patients with the same life-threatening symptoms arrive separately from a fashion show.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: A damaged man turns Cleveland, Ohio, into a hunting ground as part of a twisted plot to exact revenge on the women who hurt him.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: A woman's dream leads cops in coastal Florida to the body of a dead woman hidden in the bushes on a beach.

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: When a series of women are murdered in Baton Rouge, police draw a profile and begin DNA testing a segment of the city’s population.
programme.sub-title: Derrick Todd Lee - the Baton Rouge Serial Killer

programme.title: Killer Mysteries
programme.desc: After years of abuse, a high school valedictorian snaps, viciously stabbing his mother and leaving her for dead in the family’s garage.

programme.title: A+E After Dark
programme.desc: The staff are shocked when a young man is brought in with life-threatening stab wounds. Dr. Alastair and the team struggle as the patient's condition worsens leading to cardiac arrest.

programme.title: A+E After Dark
programme.desc: A patient is flown in by air ambulance after falling down a ditch with her mobility scooter. A woman is treated after piercing her eye on a tent peg.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: During her career as a medical examiner, Dr. G has autopsied thousands of murder victims. In this episode, Dr. G shares her most memorable case.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A decomposing body is found in a pond and a tent is found nearby. Dr. G performs the autopsy in the morgue but finds few clues other than fingerprints and mouthwash in the stomach.

programme.title: Dr. G: Medical Examiner
programme.desc: A florist meets with clients for an upcoming wedding, but she suddenly collapses to the floor. With no apparent cause of death, Dr. G worries that this case may go unsolved.

programme.title: I Shouldn't Be Alive
programme.desc: Trainee pilot Justin Kirkbride takes two friends on a sightseeing tour of the Rocky Mountains.

programme.title: Tirador
programme.desc: Decidido a probar su inocencia en una traición, Bob Lee Swagger se encuentra ahora en una tensa carrera contra todas las fuerzas de la ley de los Estados Unidos y contra una organización oscura que quiere verlo muerto.

programme.title: Misión imposible 4: Protocolo fantasma
programme.desc: El FMI se cierra cuando participa en el bombardeo del Kremlin, lo que provoca que Ethan Hunt y su nuevo equipo se conviertan en rebeldes para limpiar el nombre de su organización.

programme.title: Misión imposible 5: Nación secreta
programme.desc: Ethan y su equipo se embarcan en su misión más imposible hasta ahora, erradicando el Sindicato, una organización internacional ilegal tan altamente capacitada como ellos, comprometida con la destrucción del FMI.

programme.title: Misión imposible
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), un agente secreto, es incriminado por la muerte de su compañero de espionaje e intenta deshacerse de los asesinos del gobierno que lo persiguen. Corre contra el reloj mientras intenta descubrir la verdad.

programme.title: Misión imposible 2
programme.desc: El espía más grande del mundo, Ethan Hunt (Tom Cruise), regresa junto con la hermosa Nyah Hall para detener al agente renegado Sean Ambrose, antes de que este libere un nuevo tipo de terror en un mundo desprevenido.

programme.title: Misión: Imposible III
programme.desc: Ethan Hunt se enfrenta cara a cara con un traficante de armas peligroso y sádico al tratar de mantener su identidad en secreto para proteger a su novia.

programme.title: South Park starts at 9pm
programme.desc: CHANNEL STARTS AT 9PM Follow everyone's favorite troublemakers—Stan, Kyle, Cartman, and Kenny--from the very beginning of their unforgettable adventures.

programme.title: South Park: Pandemic 2: The Startling (Part 2)
programme.desc: Pandemic 2 - The Startling (2): Giant guinea pigs are attacking cities around the world. The boys have the key which will save humanity, but they are stuck in the Andes and bored to boot! (S12, E11)

programme.title: South Park: About Last Night...
programme.desc: About Last Night...: While the country celebrates the election of Obama, a band of unlikely super-thieves begin an audacious jewel heist. The town's Republicans fear the apocalypse is nigh. (S12, E12)

programme.title: South Park: Elementary School Musical
programme.desc: Elementary School Musical: When the all-singing and dancing musical craze hits South Park, the boys must embrace it or relinquish their popularity. Will they stick to their guns? (S12, E13)

programme.title: South Park: The Ungroundable
programme.desc: The Ungroundable: Fed up with how he is treated by his parents, the eternally innocent Butters embraces the new vampire craze a little too enthusiastically. Who will he choose to feed on? (S12, E14)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The Ring: To the amazement of the boys Kenny has a girlfriend, but they must face the might of Disney and its leader to free Kenny from the powers of his libido-squashing purity ring. (S13, E01)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The 'C**n: By day he is Eric Cartman, a fat fourth-grader. By night, he is The C**n, a crime fighting vigilante dressed in a raccoon outfit, desperate for attention. But who is Mysterion? (S13, E02)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Margaritaville: In a riff on the story of Christ, Randy implores the town to stop angering the economy with rash purchases, but a young Jew, Kyle, challenges this orthodox teaching. (S13, E03)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Eat, Pray, Queef: When a new Canadian show called The Queef Sisters starts a 'queefing' craze the men of South Park are disgusted by this new female craze and move to get it banned. (S13, E04)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fishsticks: Jimmy is angry that Cartman tries to take credit for a joke he created that is now sweeping the nation. But an angry Kanye West just can't get his head around the punch line. (S13, E05)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pinewood Derby: Randy and Stan somehow discover warp speed, allowing Earth to join the Galactic Federation of Planets, but will an alien gangster and his 'space cash' ruin everything? (S13, E06)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Fatbeard: Cartman hears of all the riches being plundered by the pirates in Somalia, so dons his eye patch and leads a motley crew off to Africa to get in on the act. (S13, E07)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dead Celebrities: The ghost of Michael Jackson refuses to accept his death, leaving the rest of the recently dead celebrities frustrated in purgatory and poor Ike having ghostly visits! (S13, E08)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Butter's Bottom B***h: Oblivious to his actions, the little innocent Butters starts up 'The Kissing Company', and is soon the most notorious pimp around. Will undercover cops ruin his fun? (S13, E09)
programme.sub-title: Hotter than Summer: Butters' Bottom Bitch

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: W. T. F.: After seeing their first live WWE wrestling match the boys decide to form their own wrestling federation... and gain a huge redneck following! (S13, E10)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Whale W****s: Kyle joins the crew of a reality documentary show who confront Japanese whalers, but finds their tactics leave a lot to be desired for and that war with Japan beckons! (S13, E11)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: The F Word: The boys confront a group of obnoxious bikers, but their methods force the townsfolk to redefine the meaning of a rather offensive word. Time to update the English Dictionary! (S13, E12)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Dances With Smurfs: Cartman's vitriol finally gets a platform when he is chosen to be the school's morning announcer, and he unashamedly abuses his position. Power corrupts... (S13, E13)

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Pee: High levels of pee in the pool cause a disaster which ruins the day for the boys, Kyle especially. Eric's xenophobia pops up again when he believes himself "the last of his species". (S13, E14)

programme.title: South Park: Weight Gain 4000
programme.desc: Weight Gain 4000: Cartman wins a school essay competition by cheating and decides to buff up before receiving his award from Kathy Lee Gifford. Mr. Garrison and Mr. Hat plot to kill her! (S1, E02)

programme.desc: Historia que narra los problemas que existen en una pareja por no tener hijos. La esposa, se la pasa evitando el tema de tener un hijo y el marido, lucha por tener a su mujer como toda una ama de casa dedicada al cuidado de el y sus futuros retoños.

programme.title: Cuatro Horas Antes De Morir
programme.desc: La historia se centra en la condena de muerte de una mujer que es acusada de un asesinato que no cometio. Su hora de muerte ya esta programada y horas antes de que esto suceda se confiesa ante un padre de un crimen nunca cometido.

programme.title: Cuatro Vidas
programme.desc: La historia relata las hazañas de una familia mexicana residente en Guatemala, entre las cuales se narran los líos amorosos y laborales de Marina, Gregorio, Fernando y Carmen.

programme.title: De Pecado En Pecado
programme.desc: Una pareja de edad descubre a las afueras de su casa a una pequeña niña abandonada, a pesar de su gran pobreza deciden criarla.

programme.title: Deseada
programme.desc: Deseada, es una bella mujer que vive en Chichen Itzá, hermosa ciudad maya. Su historia se basa en la rivalidad que se produce entre ella y su hermana quien está por casarse con un español que aun no conoce.

programme.title: Dos Gallos De Pelea
programme.desc: Dos primos parranderos acaban de heredar una fortuna y deciden a gastarla intentando conquistar a la muchacha más bonita de la región: una maestra de escuela recién llegada. La competencia llega a los extremos pues uno finge su misma muerte.

programme.title: Dos Gallos En Palenque
programme.desc: Sofia es una mujer que se hace pasar por una condesa francesa, en el aeropuerto con dirección a Venezuela se encuentra con un antiguo amigo y pretendiente que quiere convencerla para que le vuelva a dar su amor pero ella no lo hará.

programme.title: El Ansia De Matar
programme.desc: Daniel y Raúl son dos hermanos con una relación estrecha, sin embargo, esto cambia con la muerte de su padre, pues al dar con el asesino Daniel decide quedarse en Durango para continuar con su vida de juego y Raúl se va a estudiar a otro estado.

programme.title: La Armadura de Dios
programme.desc: La ex novia de Asian Hawk (Jackie Chan), una cazadora de tesoros y su mejor amiga actual son secuestradas por villanos. Para ayudar a rescatarla, tendrá que encontrar la Armadura de Dios, que hace que quien la lleve sea invencible.

programme.title: Operación Condor - La Armadura de Dios 2
programme.desc: Jackie, un talentoso cazador de tesoros, es contratado para recuperar 240 toneladas de oro que un comandante alemán, Hans von Katterling, y su regimiento enterraron en el desierto del Sahara antes del final de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento
programme.desc: Un ganster ruso retirado, actualmente escritor de novelas, es tentado a volver a la vida criminal cuando descubre que su hija va a casarse con el hijo de su enemigo.

programme.title: Atrapada en Guantánamo
programme.desc: Una guardia en Bahía Guantánamo inicia una extraña amistad con uno de los detenidos más antiguos en la instalación.

programme.title: Máxima Condena
programme.desc: Se requieren dos ex agentes de operaciones encubiertos para transferir a dos mujeres convictas a una prisión. En su camino, asaltantes desconocidos los atacan.

programme.title: Kickboxer, la venganza
programme.desc: El legendario luchador de Muay Thai Tong Po asesina sin piedad y en pleno ring a Eric Sloane. Entonces su hermano Kurt Sloane, que siempre ha vivido a la sombra de Eric ve desatado su gran deseo de venganza.

programme.title: Kickboxer Represalias
programme.desc: Kurt Sloan se ha prometido a sí mismo que no volvería a Tailandia, pero alguien le seda y le obliga a volver al país asiático. Cuando despierta, descubre que está en prisión porque quieren que se enfrente a Mongkut.

programme.title: Kung Fu Yoga
programme.desc: Un profesor de arqueología China llamado Jack, trabaja en equipo junto a una profesora india, Ashmita, y su asistente Kyra, para encontrar el tesoro perdido de Magadha.

programme.title: Wasabi
programme.desc: En Japón, para el funeral de su amor perdido hace mucho, un inspector francés duro descubre que también tiene una hija adolescente y que su vida corre peligro por la Yakuza.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.

programme.title: 2012: Ice Age
programme.desc: Cuando una erupción volcánica en Islandia envía un glaciar a América del Norte, una familia lucha por escapar de la embestida de la próxima era glacial.

programme.title: In Time
programme.desc: En un futuro en que la gente deja de envejecer a los 25 años, el dinero puede comprar la juventud inmortal.
El viaje de un hombre al futuro para salvar un mundo moribundo.

programme.title: Underworld
programme.desc: Selene, una guerrera vampiro, está inmersa en un conflicto entre vampiros y hombres lobo, mientras se enamora de Michael, un humano que es buscado por hombres lobo por razones desconocidas.

programme.title: Snow Shark
programme.desc: Hace 12 años, durante una expedición científica, 3 biólogos animales tropezaron con un gran descubrimiento que terminó en tragedia. Lo que los mató ha despertado, y ahora la leyenda de la Bestia de Nieve Antigua podría ser más que solo una leyenda.

programme.title: ¡Arañas!
programme.desc: Cuando un experimento sale mal en un laboratorio del desierto, el lugar se infesta de arañas gigantes y la gente sigue atrapada dentro. Un grupo de operaciones de guerra llega para resolver el problema, pero no tienen ni idea de a qué se enfrentan.

programme.title: El Visitante
programme.desc: Un extraño aparece de la nada tras una confusión en una estación de tren. Prot desafía a los científicos y atrae la atención del Dr. Powell, cuyo escepticismo inicial se convierte rápidamente en fascinación y asombro.

programme.title: Dark Parasite
programme.desc: Una pandilla de ladrones busca refugio con un anfitrión en un edificio de apartamentos deteriorado situado en los suburbios. Sin que ellos lo sepan, en el sótano acecha un enigmático ser extraterrestre que posee habilidades telepáticas.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La ciencia moderna nos afirma que, en el nivel más simple, el mundo material no es más que energía y que todos estamos conectados de forma física con el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ron y Nancy están convencidos de que su nuevo hogar es demasiado bueno para ser verdad: la histórica casa Baltimore se adapta de forma ideal a su presupuesto y además es tan grande como para alojar a su gran familia.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Existen algunos lazos que no pueden romperse, tal como el vínculo que se establece entre una madre y su hija... o el vínculo psíquico entre un asesino y su víctima.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Cuando Clara y su familia se mudan a una pequeña casa en la zona rural de Hinsdale, Nueva York, se dan cuenta de que la paz de la vida en el campo es simplemente una ilusión y la amenaza de muerte es muy real.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La casa de rancho de Ed y Beth parece el lugar perfecto para criar a su niño pequeño, hasta que descubren que no están solos y una espesa niebla oscura se cierne sobre la casa y crece día a día.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la vida, las personas pueden vivir atormentadas por sus propios crímenes. Lo mismo también puede ocurrir en la muerte: espíritus enojados pueden quedar estacionados en el mismo lugar donde perdieron su humanidad.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: ¿Qué tan diferente podría ser nuestra realidad si no pudiéramos sentir y comunicarnos de las formas más convencionales? Para Marie, este es un tema que forma parte de su día a día. Su hija Julie padece una condición mental que la debilita.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que los fantasmas son espíritus humanos que deben lidiar con asuntos aún pendientes y que quizás puedan necesitar la ayuda de los vivos, con el fin de encontrar la paz entre los muertos.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Deb y Tony acaban de comenzar su vida juntos. Con su primer hijo en camino, la pareja trabajadora se muda a una pintoresca casa en Atchison, en el estado de Kansas, con muchas esperanzas en el futuro.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la isla de Taiwán muchas personas creen que no existen fronteras entre el mundo material y el reino espiritual. Los fantasmas forman parte de la vida cotidiana.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Hay un demonio suelto en una casa de Connecticut, y un niño de 12 años se lleva la peor parte de su ira. Él ve a un anciano con pezuñas y cuernos, lo golpean y lo arrojan y finalmente es poseído. Solo un exorcismo salvará su alma.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Se ha dicho que cada fotografía roba una parte del alma de un hombre. Entonces, ¿qué ocurre con todas esas partes cuando la persona ya ha fallecido?

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Los niños a menudo se encuentran a merced del mundo de los adultos y, algunas veces, se sienten incapaces de influir en el curso de sus propias existencias.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: En la inocencia de la infancia, el miedo es perfecto, y no resulta influenciado por la racionalidad adulta, lo cual supone que se puede comprender a cabalidad el mundo que nos rodea.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Algunas personas creen que todo nuestro conocimiento del mundo nos llega a través de la percepción sensorial y los poderes del razonamiento. Otras, en cambio, piensan que podemos obtener conocimiento por medio de la intuición.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: La dinámica de las personas que viven bajo un mismo techo puede tener un equilibrio delicado. Mike y su novia, Lisa, mantienen una relación sana y, sin nada que les preocupe, se mudan juntos, pero no están solos en su nueva casa.

programme.title: Historias de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Ciertos mitos nativos norteamericanos hablan de criaturas sobrenaturales que protegen a los muertos. Los primeros exploradores de algunas tribus algonquinas del noreste de los Estados Unidos contaban historias sobre hombres lobo.

programme.title: Operación Carambola
programme.desc: El falso agente de seguridad Ayala, nombra a Capulina como su ayudante numero 13, para preparar la operación carambola. Capulina se da cuenta que él es carnada del criminal y decide unirse a los otros agentes para acabar con la organización.

programme.title: Rosario
programme.desc: Una mujer mata accidentalmente a su marido mientras actuaba en una obra de teatro.

programme.title: Santo Contra Capulina
programme.desc: Capulina es un gran admirador del campion el Santo, quien en su tiempo libre ayuda a la policia a resolver difíciles casos criminales. Un cientifico crea un robot igual a Capulina para matar al Santo. El robot y el Santo pronto se enfrentan en la arena.

programme.title: Santo contra los cazadores de cabezas
programme.desc: El valiente e infatigable luchador se encuentra en el Amazonas, enfrentado a los Jíbaros para salvar a una heroína.

programme.title: Tin Tan y Las Modelos
programme.desc: Tin-Tan y su esposa Severa son los directores del Patronato de la Moral y Etica Social. Sin embargo Tin-Tan tuvo como antepasado a Casanova, quien le da tres maravillosas lecciones de amor con tres hermosas jovenes, Rosa, Teresa y Mapita.

programme.title: Toña Machetes
programme.desc: Toña Machetes es una brava mujer que logró elevarse por encima de los prejuicios sociales de los años 30. Dueña de una gran extensión de tierra y temida por su carácter, vive separada de su esposo aristócrata y acechada por constantes amenazas de muerte.

programme.title: Tres lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Tin-Tan es un vendedor de productos de belleza que conoce aun grupo de hermosas jóvenes que aspiran a ser modelos. Decide ayudarlas y organiza una exhibición de modas que las hace triunfar en la Televisión.

programme.title: Yo soy Chucho el Roto
programme.desc: El carpintero Jesús Arriaga se enamora de Erica Matilde, pero los tíos de ella se oponen a la relación y lo arrestan por robo. Se fuga de la cárcel y se convierte en un bandido generoso.

programme.title: Arriba Las Manos Texano
programme.desc: El texano, hijo de Manuel Saldivar, un asesino cruel y desalmado, emprende un viaje para llegar al rancho de Joe Pastrana. Al llegar se entera por su hija, que Joe a muerto victima de una balacera comandada por Jim, un cruel hombre.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: El Misterio del Látigo Negro
programme.desc: Con la misma moneda: en el pueblo de San Fernando, el comisario don Miguel, su hija Rosita y Julian, novio de ella, reciben a Roberto, que llega con su hermana enferma Laura Elena y que desea adquirir tierras del lugar.

programme.title: Aventuras Del Látigo Negro: La Marca del Gavilán
programme.desc: La marca del gavilan: en San Fernand, los compadres Manuel y Jose, sicarios del gavilan, asesinan por equivocacion al viudo Pablo, padre de un bebe a quien llama su tesoro: eso le cuesta la vida.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Las niñas asiáticas de la escuela están dibujando imágenes románticas al estilo manga de Tweek y Craig, creando una gran confusión entre los alumnos y los padres.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Mientras Kenny y los chicos juegan a ser ninjas, todos en South Park empiezan a creer que en realidad forman parte de una organización terrorista.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC está extremadamente furioso con uno de sus alumnos, Jimmy Valmer.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El director PC desaparece con dos estudiantes de cuarto grado.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: La desconfianza entre Kyle y Stan ha roto su amistad, y Kyle se ha arrojado en una peligrosa alianza.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: El Himno Nacional estadounidense es modificado por J.J. Abrams. Mientras tanto, el Sr. Garrison intenta lanzar las Elecciones Presidenciales contra Hillary Clinton.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos deciden que tienen que acabar con Cartman porque están convencidos de que él es el Troll. Mientras tanto, el padre de Kyle logra mantener en secreto su identidad.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: A medida que continúa su asedio virtual a todos, Gerald está encantado con la atención de los medios.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Los chicos se unen para protestar por sus derechos mostrando algunas partes de sus cuerpos sin ropa.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gran Basura desiste de la carrera por la presidencia. Mientras tanto, Gerald (CazaPutas42) lucha con los demás Trolls para detener el movimiento antitroll de Dinamarca.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Una ciudad entera en Colorado es hackeada. Gerald y Cartman pueden perderlo todo cuando la historia de su actividad en Internet se hace pública.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Gerald se encuentra cara a cara con el Cazador de Trolls. Cartman teme que Heidi descubra su pasado. El director PC intenta lograr la paz entre los chicos y las chicas de la escuela.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Garrison, que recientemente recibió la apariencia de Donald Trump, ha sido electo como nuevo presidente de los Estados Unidos. Gerald intenta escapar del temido cazador de trolls danés.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman está seguro de que Butters está intentando robarle a su novia.

programme.title: South Park
programme.desc: Cartman intenta convencer a los científicos de que ir a Marte es una mala idea. Kyle y Ike desafían a su mamá e intentan, junto con todos los chicos, salvar al mundo de una destrucción segura.

programme.title: South Park

programme.title: El velo pintado
programme.desc: Un médico británico lucha contra una epidemia de cólera en un pequeño pueblo chino, mientras está atrapado en un matrimonio sin amor con una mujer infiel.

programme.title: The Ghost Writer
programme.desc: El cineasta Roman Polanski aumenta el suspense en un thriller sobre un escritor (Ewan McGregor) que redacta las memorias de un ex primer ministro (Pierce Brosnan).

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Arcadia
programme.desc: Greta, de 12 años, es llevada a través del país por su padre, quien intenta mantener unida a su familia tras la ruptura de su matrimonio.

programme.title: Juana de Arco
programme.desc: Guiada por visiones divinas, Juana de Arco, adolescente del siglo XV, lidera a Francia en guerra. Parte 1.

programme.title: Juana de Arco
programme.desc: Guiada por visiones divinas, Juana de Arco, adolescente del siglo XV, lidera a Francia en guerra. Parte 2.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 1
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: Hitler: El ascenso del mal - Parte 2
programme.desc: Una perspectiva única, que perfila la vida de Adolf Hitler como un niño y su ascenso a través de las filas del Partido Nacional Alemán de los Trabajadores antes de la Segunda Guerra Mundial.

programme.title: El Lute II: Mañana seré libre
programme.desc: El Lute escapa de la prisión de El Puerto de Santa María. Lo primero que hace tras su huida es acudir a sus hermanos para pedirles ayuda.

programme.title: Redada mortal
programme.desc: Un hábil luchador es contratado para neutralizar al equipo de seguridad de una fábrica local y permitir que su empleador extorsione a su poderoso dueño.

programme.title: El último hijo
programme.desc: El forajido Isaac LeMay está en las últimas, perseguido como un perro. Está dispuesto a acabar con todo, pero su maldición permanece. Su hijo Cal es aún peor que él, y deja un reguero de sangre y destrucción por donde pasa.

programme.title: Los últimos supervivientes
programme.desc: Al fin ocurrió el apocalipsis, y Jake recuerda cómo su padre Troy lo sacó del infierno para refugiarse en un remoto bosque, rodeados de nieve. Pero la realidad, que no es como Jake cree, se abrirá paso hasta su remota guarida.

programme.title: Batalla espacial: La armada ataca
programme.desc: En 2420, después de que una raza de alienígenas y poderosos magos esclavizaran a gran parte de la humanidad, un grupo de rebeldes organiza un contraataque pilotando una flota de naves espaciales.

programme.title: White Space
programme.desc: La tripulación de una nave pesquera espacial se enfrenta a una criatura cósmica gigantesca y mortal mientras opera en un sector inexplorado del espacio.

programme.title: Robot Wasteland
programme.desc: En un mundo postapocalíptico dominado por máquinas rebeldes y bandas de saqueadores, una madre y su hija luchan por proteger la última fuente de agua limpia.

programme.title: Las nuevas aventuras de Aladino
programme.desc: Dos empleados fracasados de unos grandes almacenes planean robar la tienda tras el cierre. Pero cuando un grupo de niños aparece pidiendo una historia, los hombres improvisan y empiezan a contar su propia versión del cuento de Aladino.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: Valentine: venganza oscura
programme.desc: Una joven se involucra con un hombre con la idea de que va a hacer una película cuando lo que él pretende es convertirla en vigilante enmascarada.

programme.title: Vuelo 192
programme.desc: Sarah Plummer, agente del FBI, ve cómo su familia es secuestrada durante un vuelo a Washington. Cuando una misteriosa pasajera se sienta a su lado, deberá tomar una decisión que puede costarle la vida de su marido y su hijo.

programme.title: Papa Moll & The Chocolate Factory
programme.desc: El caos se apodera de la casa el único fin de semana que el Señor Moll se queda solo al cuidado de los niños. Mientras él trabaja, los niños comienzan una pelea con los niños del vecino. Una lucha de chocolatinas, tareas para el cole y un Perro Circense.

programme.title: La boda de Rosa
programme.desc: A punto de cumplir 45 años, Rosa se da cuenta de que siempre ha vivido su vida para servir a los demás, por lo que decide dejarlo todo atrás, tomar las riendas de su vida y cumplir su sueño de emprender su propio negocio.

programme.title: Manolito Gafotas
programme.desc: El verano se presenta francamente mal para Manolito Gafotas. Está condenado, un año más, a pasar las vacaciones en su pequeño piso de Carabanchel Alto, con su madre, su abuelo y su hermano pequeño.

programme.title: Pettson & Findus
programme.desc: El señor Pettson vive en una pequeña casa, cortando madera, haciendo trabajos peculiares, trabajando en sus inventos, pescando, y cuidando de sus gallinas. Parece que tiene todo en orden hasta que su vecina le da un pequeño gato para que le haga compañía.

programme.title: Mi Amigo Raffi
programme.desc: Sammy, de ocho años, tiene pequeño roedor que no es un hamster cualquiera: no sólo puede jugar al fútbol sino que también puede detectar materiales de contrabando. Un día Raffi desaparece pero nadie tiempo para ayudarle a buscarlo.

programme.title: Storm y la carta prohibida de Lutero
programme.desc: Storm Voeten, hijo del copista Klaas Voeten, se convierte en la diana de una cacería de la Inquisición. Ayudado por Marieke, una misteriosa chica que vive en las cloacas de Antwerp, Storm es capturado en una carrera contrarreloj para salvar a su padre.

programme.title: Tapas
programme.desc: Varias historias se entrelazan en un barrio de trabajadores de una gran ciudad.

programme.title: Dinosaurios
programme.desc: Tres niños que viajan en el tiempo 65 millones de años atrás, donde son recogidos por una mamá dinosaurio.

programme.title: Una Momia Divertida: El Escarabajo Dorado
programme.desc: En un aburrido pueblo en el que nunca pasa nada, un chico encuentra una momia viva en su habitación. Este es el comienzo de una increíble amistad que le llevará a aprender sobre la vida.

programme.title: Una momia divertida: La esfinge de Shákaba
programme.desc: En un aburrido pueblo en el que nunca pasa nada, un chico encuentra una momia viva en su habitación. Este es el comienzo de una increíble amistad que le llevará a aprender sobre la vida.

programme.title: La historia de Wim de la A a la Z
programme.desc: Wim, de nueve años, vive en un orfanato y sueña con ir a la escuela. En lugar de eso es obligado a trabajar en el sótano del orfanato fabricando escobas ilegales.

programme.title: Gangster Nº 1
programme.desc: Un mafioso recuerda su ascenso en el Londres de los años sesenta. La ambición y la envidia lo llevan a traicionar a su mentor, Freddie Mays, para convertirse en el gánster más temido de la ciudad.

programme.title: Lock & Stock
programme.desc: Cuatro colegas acaban endeudados hasta las cejas con un tipo duro del East End y sus secuaces tras una partida de cartas amañada.

programme.title: Asesinos natos
programme.desc: Los locos amantes Mickey y Mallory Knox van asesinando a través de los Estados Unidos y matan a más de cincuenta personas en unas pocas semanas. Mientras la policía persigue a la pareja, ¡el público sensacionalista está encantado!

programme.title: Mr. Jones
programme.desc: En los años 30, un periodista de investigación británico viaja a lo más profundo de la Unión Soviética para descubrir una conspiración internacional.

programme.title: El intruso
programme.desc: Tras un trágico accidente, un hombre se convierte en el objetivo de la peligrosa obsesión de otro testigo.

programme.title: Crupier
programme.desc: Jack Manfred, un aspirante a escritor con problemas económicos, decide aceptar un trabajo de croupier para salir adelante. Lo malo es que en el casino entabla relación con una empleada que lo arrastra por caminos peligrosos.

programme.title: Past Sins
programme.desc: Donna, una prestigiosa abogada, debe defender el caso de una mujer cuyo ADN ha sido encontrado en un asesinato cometido hace 20 años.

programme.title: Instafama
programme.desc: Una fanática desquiciada de las redes sociales inculpa a su mejor amiga por asesinato.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: Tras una temporada en Pekín, Roy y Jessie deciden viajar a Moscú en el Transiberiano, el ferrocarril que une la Rusia europea con las provincias rusas del Lejano Oriente.

programme.title: Breve encuentro
programme.desc: Adaptación televisiva de la obra de Noël Coward. Un hombre y una mujer no pueden evitar enamorarse.

programme.title: Rebelde entre el centeno

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: John McLaughlin & Mahavishnu Orchestra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, the acclaimed jazz fusion group Mahavishnu Orchestra led by guitarist John McLaughlin took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. This third incarnation of the group featured an outstanding lineup, with Jim Beard on keyboards, Jonas Hellborg on bass, Danny Gottlieb on drums, and Bill Evans on saxophone.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Def Leppard
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track. They encored with a selection of other classics including When Love and Hate Collide, Let's Get Rocked and Photograph. Another career defining moment from the band capture in 4K video and 5.1 audio.

programme.title: The Clash
programme.sub-title: Rebel Truce: The history of The Clash
programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one the greatest front men in rock'n'Roll music history. 'Rebel Truce' have the visual style and excitement of the Clash with front man Jerry in particular delivering an outstanding live performance that has won over even the most sceptical Clash fans.

programme.title: Peter Frampton
programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.desc: A 5 hour long ambient nature film featuring the spectacular sights and sounds of the legendary 11-mile long Kalalau Trail. programme.title: Lake Tahoe Shoreline Rocks
programme.desc: Transport yourself to the iconic crystal blue shoreline of Lake Tahoe as you let your feet soak in the cool healing waters along a rugged rocky point. Listen as the sound of the water splashing on the rocks washes away any worries you might have, and then as you expand your horizons, notice the distant stunning snow covered peaks and occasional water-goers. This fixed-angle scene was captured on the eastern shoreline of Lake Tahoe and is presented in 4K resolution for maximum immersion.

programme.title: Rainbow Reef Relaxation 1
programme.desc: Sit back, relax and enjoy the dazzling world of coral reefs in 4K you embark on a journey through some of the most vibrant underwater reefs on our blue planet - including many scenes which no longer look like this due to coral bleaching. From the cinematographer: "The footage for this film was shot over a period of some years in French Polynesia, Micronesia, Indonesia and East Timor. Unfortunately there are not that vibrant anymore today. Coral reefs have suffered from the rise of water temperature, rise in acidity, destructive fishing methods and severe storms caused by climate change." - Peter Schneider. "Rainbow Reef Relaxation" is a 3-hour long, sweeping yet majestic & vibrant underwater journey to the world's most beautiful lagoons, as captured by Nature Relaxation collaborator Peter Schneider (Underwatercam) paired with ambient underwater sounds and brand new ambient music by the Cynic Project. Filmed in High Definition several years ago, thanks to its age this film offers magical glimpses of an underwater world that is bursting with life, color, and beauty.

programme.desc: When Baxter Billings (David Blue - SGU Stargate Universe, Ugly Betty) wins a small fortune at his local shopping mall, he decides to become a Secret Santa to the people in his hometown. His anonymous philanthropy is contagious and soon enough the joy of giving at Christmas spreads across town. Along the way, Baxter forms a close friendship with Pamela (Ashley Jones - True Blood, The Bold and the Beautiful) and her young son Westin. He thinks he might be falling for Pamela... but there's one problem, he's already engaged! This Christmas, Baxter will have to choose between keeping promises or following his heart.

programme.desc: Do you believe in Santa Claus? On the eve of Christmas a young boy sets out to discover the truth behind several strange goings on in his small isolated village. Why have all the reindeer been slaughtered? Who took all the hairdryers and radiators? And where have all the children gone? Seal the chimney. Lock the doors. Hide your children. This year the real Santa Claus is coming to town.

programme.title: Last Days in the Desert
programme.desc: As Jesus begins his journey out of the wilderness following forty days of fasting and praying, he struggles with the Devil over the fate of a family in crisis. This powerful drama depicting an imagined chapter from Jesus' life stars Golden Globe winner Ewan McGregor (Trainspotting, Star Wars franchise), Academy Award nominee Ciarn Hinds (Belfast, Game of Thrones), and Tye Sheridan (Mud, X-Men franchise).

programme.title: Merry Good Enough
programme.desc: Lucy Raulie has always had a complicated relationship with her family, but when her mother disappears on Christmas Eve, the dysfunctional family hit a new all-time low. Aided by her reluctant siblings in an attempt to bring the family back together, the Raulie kids may get more than they bargained for when their eccentric father, George, also shows up to "help" in the search for their wayward mom. A razor-sharp and delightfully heartwarming festive comedy, packed with classic Christmas songs and a stand-out ensemble cast, including Joel Murray (Mad Men), Sawyer Spielberg (Masters of the Air), Susan Gallagher (Cobra Kai), Neil Casey (Ghostbusters, Avenue 5), Comfort Clinton (Billions, FBI), Sophie von Haselberg (Give Me Pity, Pose) and Raye Spielberg.

programme.title: American Fighter

A desperate teenager is forced into the dangerous world of underground fighting to win enough money to save his ailing mother.

programme.title: Death Trench

The Germans have lost control of a highly contagious biological weapon that turns its victims into deranged killers. The Allies find themselves trapped underground with hordes of the infected, a rapidly spreading disease and a team of German Stormtroopers dispatched to clean up the mess

programme.title: Angelica

Following the birth of their daughter, a young couple begin to experience strange happenings in their home. When the eerie late-night visits become ever more menacing, they decide to fight the supernatural force. Prepare to be spooked!

His past is just that, in the past but sometimes trouble cannot be ignored. As a violent gang torments the local community, Ryan returns to his trade for one final killing spree where he becomes judge, jury and executioner.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah
programme.sub-title: Live at A to JazZ Festival, Sofia
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music” an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content. Trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah's quintet, which includes drummer Corey Fonville, percussionist Weedie Braimah, pianist Lawrence Fields, and bass guitarist Max Mucha, delivered a performance that defied boundaries and expectations.

programme.title: Dexter Gordon
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Christian McBride
programme.desc: On July 20, 2018, double bassist Christian McBride presented his band ‘New Jawn' at the Malta Jazz Festival. A five-time Grammy winner, McBride is one of the most requested, most recorded, and most respected figures in the music world today. Hailing from Philadelphia, this music luminary combines jazz, R&B, pop/rock, hip hop/neo-soul, and classical. Gracing the Malta Jazz stage with him are Nasheet Waits (drums), Marcus Strickland (tenor sax), and Josh Evans (trumpet).

programme.title: John McLaughlin & Mahavishnu Orchestra
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1986, the acclaimed jazz fusion group Mahavishnu Orchestra led by guitarist John McLaughlin took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. This third incarnation of the group featured an outstanding lineup, with Jim Beard on keyboards, Jonas Hellborg on bass, Danny Gottlieb on drums, and Bill Evans on saxophone.

programme.title: Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, Danish National Symphony Orchestra & Emma Smith
programme.desc: One night only! Welcome to the spectacular and decadent world of The Babylon Hotel, where music pours out of every crevice like bubbling champagne. In this concert, the upper class meets the underworld in a melting pot of euphoria and extravagance, nostalgia and pleasure with a carefree sinfulness only seen in the exuberant nightlife of the 1920s around the world. The concert features iconic music from movies and series, such as The Great Gatsby, Burlesque, and Babylon Berlin. The music is performed by the Danish National Symphony Orchestra and DR Big Band under the direction of Miho Hazama. The concert also features the Moka Efti Orchestra, and singers Madame le Pustra, Emma Smith, Mademoiselle Karen, Jakob Munch, and Nikko Weidemann, as well as dancers of Sweet Burlesque. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in May 2023.

programme.title: The Philharmonics
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron. In May 1921, the likes of Arnold Schönberg, Alban Berg, and Anton Webern wrote these chamber music arrangements to raise funds for their Society for Private Musical Performances. Although both the concert and the auction of the scores were very successful, the Society eventually went under. In addition to these pieces by Strauss, The Philharmonics perform works by Fritz Kreisler, Leopold Godowsky, as well as The Philharmonics's first violinist, Tibor Kováč. The program comes to an end with Godowsky's tribute to the city: Alt Wien.

programme.title: Anabel de la Mora, Andrés Carrillo, Daniel Cerón & Coro de la Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Rodolfo Barráez conducts the Orchestra and Choir of the Academia de Musica del Palacia de Mineria in a performance of Carl Orff's cantata Carmina Burana. Soloists are Anabel de la Mora (soprano), Andrés Carrillo (tenor) and Daniel Cerón (baritone). Carmina Burana, composed in 1935 and 1936, is based on 24 poems from a medieval manuscript of the same name. The full title is "Songs from Beuern: Secular songs for singers and choruses to be sung together with instruments and magical images". It was first performed at the Oper Frankfurt on June 8, 1937.

programme.title: Martha Argerich, Herbert Blomstedt & Lucerne Festival Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 1 & Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: At the age of seven, Argentine pianist Martha Argerich made her debut with Ludwig van Beethoven's Piano Concerto No. 1 in C major, Op. 15, a piece that would accompany her throughout her career. The celebrated pianist performs this signature piece at the Lucerne Festival with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra under the baton of Swedish conductor Herbert Blomstedt, who makes his festival debut with the orchestra. Beethoven's Symphony No. 2 in D major, Op. 36, is also on the program. This performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Carlos Miguel Prieto & Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence. The symphony is structured in six movements, moving from the "awakening of nature" to a spiritual conclusion, inspired by Nietzsche and folk poetry.

programme.title: Def Leppard
programme.desc: Sheffield's finest make their long-awaited debut at London's O2m Arena in November 2018. Marking the 31st anniversary of Hysteria they played the whole of the ground breaking album in chronological order featuring hits like Pour Some Sugar on Me, Animal, Women and the title track. They encored with a selection of other classics including When Love and Hate Collide, Let's Get Rocked and Photograph. Another career defining moment from the band capture in 4K video and 5.1 audio.

programme.title: The Clash
programme.sub-title: Rebel Truce: The history of The Clash
programme.desc: The Clash were one of the most influential bands to blow up from the Punk rock scene of 1977, with the late Joe Strummer revered as one the greatest front men in rock'n'Roll music history. 'Rebel Truce' have the visual style and excitement of the Clash with front man Jerry in particular delivering an outstanding live performance that has won over even the most sceptical Clash fans.

programme.title: Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers
programme.desc: Filmed live from the Vic Theatre, Chicago, Illinois, USA in April 2003 for the 'Soundstage' TV series.

programme.title: Peter Frampton
programme.sub-title: FCA! 35 Tour: An Evening With Peter Frampton
programme.desc: In 2011, Grammy Award winning guitarist Peter Frampton embarked on a world tour celebrating the 35th anniversary of his multi-platinum selling live album "Frampton Comes Alive!". Peter Frampton has chosen what he feels are the best performances of each track for this concert film. He remains one of rock's most iconic guitarists and these live performances catch him at his very best.

programme.title: Bachman & Turner
programme.desc: Randy Bachman and C.F. “Fred” Turner were the core members of Bachman-Turner Overdrive throughout their commercial heyday in the seventies, sharing duties on the lead vocals with Bachman contributing lead guitar and Turner the bass. Between them they also composed the vast majority of the band's many hit singles. Reuniting at the end of 2009 they released an eponymous album in 2010 and in November of that year they performed at the famous Roseland Ballroom in New York City as part of their North American tour.

programme.title: A Day on the Napali Coast 4
programme.desc: A 5 hour long ambient nature film featuring the spectacular sights and sounds of the legendary 11-mile long Kalalau Trail. Featuring hundreds of breathtaking yet tranquil scenes with stereo audio, this video begins on Kalalau Beach at sunrise and progresses along the trail over the course of nearly a full day. programme.title: Autumn in Amsterdam
